room.title: Dynamic Heating Control
room.description: Choose the thermostat, room temperature sensor and schedule helper. Control stays disabled after setup.

data.window_temperature: Temperature while window is open (°C, optional)
data.calibration: Calibrate setpoint with the room sensor

data_description.person_entities: Comfort heating is allowed when at least one selected person or device tracker is home. Device trackers are recommended for simple home/not-home states.
data_description.enter_home_duration: The home state must remain stable for this long before comfort heating is allowed.
data_description.leaving_home_duration: After the last selected person leaves, wait this long before switching to setback temperature.
data_description.guest_entity: An active guest toggle counts as someone being home.
data_description.proximity_zone: Pick the zone of the Proximity integration, for example Home. The distance and direction sensors of this room's people are found automatically. The zone only counts while none of these people is home; while at least one is home it sleeps.
data_description.proximity_duration: The direction must continuously point towards home within the configured range for this long before comfort heating is allowed. Changing distance readings do not restart the timer; a direction change or unavailable reading does.
data_description.proximity_distance: Maximum approach distance in meters. Distance values in m, km, miles, feet or yards are normalized to meters before comparison.
data_description.presence_entity: Comfort heating is allowed only while this sensor reports presence and the configured household presence source also allows heating.
data_description.presence_schedule_entity: The presence sensor is used only while this schedule is on. When off, sensor motion is ignored.
data_description.presence_on_duration: Presence must remain on for this long before it is accepted.
data_description.presence_off_duration: After the sensor turns off, keep presence accepted for this long before switching to setback.
data_description.proximity_max_age: If the distance sensor has not updated within this duration, its position is considered stale. No new heating decision is made from stale proximity data; a person/guest tracker that already confirms home still takes precedence.
data_description.away_temperature: Setpoint while nobody is home. Leave empty to keep using the setback temperature. Must be lower than the comfort temperature.
data_description.heating_limit_temperature: At or above this outdoor temperature the room stays at the setback temperature, even during comfort periods, and preheating is skipped. Normal heating resumes once it is 1 °C cooler. Uses the outdoor sensor, otherwise the weather entity temperature. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.window_open_delay: Setback starts only after the window stayed open this long. Short airing or a draft does not change the setpoint. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_close_delay: After closing, the window setback is kept this long so the room air settles. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_temperature: Own setpoint while a window is open, e.g. 15 °C. Leave empty to use the eco or away temperature as before. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.frost_protection_temperature: No setpoint goes below this value, not even with an open window or while away, e.g. 12 °C. Leave empty to disable. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.heating_season_entity: Switch or sensor for the heating season, e.g. a winter mode. While it is OFF the room is not heated: the setpoint goes to the frost protection temperature or, without one, the thermostat minimum. If the entity is unavailable, heating continues normally. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.additional_climate_entities: Further radiator thermostats of the same room. They get the same setpoint as the main thermostat, like a climate group. An unavailable additional thermostat is skipped; a manual change on any of them pauses control for the room.
data_description.calibration: The thermostat measures right at the radiator. When enabled, its setpoint is shifted by the difference between thermostat and room temperature (like Better Thermostat's target-temperature calibration) so it regulates on the room sensor. The difference is recomputed at most every 10 minutes. Do not enable when the selected thermostat already is a Better Thermostat.
data_description.external_temperature: For thermostats with an external temperature input (e.g. Aqara E1 via Zigbee2MQTT): the integration switches them to the external sensor and sends them the room sensor's temperature, like Better Thermostat. The valve then regulates on the room temperature itself, so no calibration is needed for these thermostats. While control is off or the room sensor is unavailable they are switched back to their own sensor.
data_description.valve_maintenance: Against calcification the valves are fully opened for 5 minutes and then fully closed for 5 minutes once a week around 11:00 (thermostat maximum and minimum temperature), as in Better Thermostat. Postponed while a window is open or control is manually overridden. Only while control is active.
data_description.hysteresis: A recomputed calibration is only applied when it changed by at least this value, so the thermostats are not re-adjusted for every small temperature fluctuation. 0 disables the hysteresis.
data_description.window_drop_detection: When the room cools by 1 °C within 10 minutes it is lowered for 15 minutes as with an open window. Works in addition to a window contact.

data_description.notify_service: For the weekly report, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.house_calendar: Calendar or schedule for the whole house. A running event picks the schedule its title or "zeitplan: Ferien" names in every room. With "komfort: an" or "temperature: 21" in the description it is comfort time in every room.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: The essentials of the room. Comfort must be above the setback temperature.

data_description.climate_entity: Select the climate entity this room controller may adjust. Avoid running another automation that writes targets to the same thermostat.
data_description.additional_climate_entities: Further radiator thermostats of the same room. They get the same setpoint as the main thermostat, like a climate group. An unavailable additional thermostat is skipped; a manual change on any of them pauses control for the room.
data_description.room_temperature_entity: Use a room sensor in °C. The value is used to estimate heat-up and cool-down behaviour.
data_description.schedule_entity: A Home Assistant schedule entity: ON means comfort time. Its next_event is used to plan preheating.
data_description.comfort_temperature: Desired room temperature during active comfort periods.
data_description.eco_temperature: Setback target outside comfort periods, during absence or when a window is open. It must be below the comfort target.
data_description.max_preheat_minutes: Hard limit for how early preheating may start.
data_description.frost_protection_temperature: No setpoint goes below this value, not even with an open window or while away, e.g. 12 °C. Leave empty to disable. Must be below the comfort temperature.

valves.title: Valves in detail
valves.description: How the valves are driven. The defaults suit most rooms.

data.calibration: Calibrate setpoint with the room sensor
data.external_temperature: Send the room temperature to the thermostats
data.sync_manual_change: Turning a valve applies to the room
data.valve_fallback: Fallback schedule in the valve on shutdown

data_description.calibration: The thermostat measures right at the radiator. When enabled, its setpoint is shifted by the difference between thermostat and room temperature (like Better Thermostat's target-temperature calibration) so it regulates on the room sensor. The difference is recomputed at most every 10 minutes. Do not enable when the selected thermostat already is a Better Thermostat.
data_description.external_temperature: For thermostats with an external temperature input (e.g. Aqara E1 via Zigbee2MQTT): the integration switches them to the external sensor and sends them the room sensor's temperature, like Better Thermostat. The valve then regulates on the room temperature itself, so no calibration is needed for these thermostats. While control is off or the room sensor is unavailable they are switched back to their own sensor.
data_description.valve_maintenance: Against calcification the valves are fully opened for 5 minutes and then fully closed for 5 minutes once a week around 11:00 (thermostat maximum and minimum temperature), as in Better Thermostat. Postponed while a window is open or control is manually overridden. Only while control is active.
data_description.maintenance_weekday: Day the valves are exercised. "Every 7 days" means seven days after the last run.
data_description.maintenance_duration: How long the valves stay fully open, then closed.
data_description.hysteresis: A recomputed calibration is only applied when it changed by at least this value, so the thermostats are not re-adjusted for every small temperature fluctuation. 0 disables the hysteresis.
data_description.command_delay: Wait between two commands to valves, also across rooms, so Zigbee does not drop any when many are sent at once. 0 = no pause.
data_description.sync_manual_change: A setpoint turned at a thermostat goes to every thermostat of the room and holds as quick mode Manuell for the chosen duration. Off: control only pauses until the next mode change.
data_description.lock_valves: A setpoint turned at a thermostat is set back to the room's target at once (like Better Thermostat's child lock or Climate Group Helper's lock sync mode). Wins over 'Turning a valve applies to the room'.
data_description.aggressive_range: When the room is more than this below or above the target, target plus or minus the offset is sent so sluggish valves open or close decisively. Leave empty to turn off.
data_description.aggressive_offset: How far the sent setpoint is raised or lowered outside the range.
data_description.valve_fallback: When Home Assistant shuts down, valves with their own schedule (e.g. Aqara E1) get today's comfort and eco times and use their own sensor. After the start this is switched off again. Does not help on power loss or a crash.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: More schedules, boost, the quick mode temperatures and "warm up".

data_description.additional_schedule_entities: Further comfort schedules, e.g. holidays or home office. Pick the active one with the room's "Zeitplan" entity; without a choice the first schedule applies.
data_description.eco_schedule_entity: Schedule helper whose blocks carry a temperature in their additional data (e.g. temperature: 17). While a block is active it replaces the setback temperature, at most up to the comfort temperature.
data_description.boost_temperature: Target temperature while the "Boost" switch is on. Boost wins over schedule, presence and heating limit, but not over an open window or the heating season being off.
data_description.boost_duration: The boost turns itself off after this time.
data_description.home_temperature: Target of the "Zuhause" (home) button and mode, like Better Thermostat's home preset.
data_description.activity_temperature: Target of the "Aktivität" (activity) button and mode, like Better Thermostat's activity preset.
data_description.sleep_temperature: Target of the "Schlafen" (sleep) button and mode, like Better Thermostat's sleep preset. "Abwesend" (away) uses the away temperature, or eco without one.
data_description.warm_up_step: The "Kurz wärmer" button (also via Alexa) raises the current target by this much. Pressing again adds another step (at most three).
data_description.warm_up_duration: Afterwards the room returns to automatic on its own.

presence.title: People and presence
presence.description: Configure who is home and optional indoor presence detection. A guest toggle counts as someone being home. Sensor reaction delays reduce short false triggers.

data.away_offset: Setback while the room is empty (°C, optional)

data_description.person_entities: Comfort is allowed when at least one selected person or device tracker is home. Device trackers with simple home/not_home states are usually most predictable.
data_description.enter_home_duration: The home state must remain stable this long before arrival is accepted.
data_description.leaving_home_duration: Keep the previous home state for this grace period after a departure signal.
data_description.guest_entity: An ON input_boolean or binary sensor counts as someone being home.
data_description.presence_entity: Optional indoor presence or motion sensor. When used with people or proximity, both the household and this sensor must allow comfort heating.
data_description.presence_schedule_entity: The indoor presence sensor is considered only while this schedule is ON. Leave blank to use the sensor all day.
data_description.presence_on_duration: Presence must remain ON for this long before it is accepted.
data_description.presence_off_duration: After OFF, retain the previous presence decision for this long to avoid quick setbacks.
data_description.away_temperature: Setpoint while nobody is home. Leave empty to keep using the setback temperature. Must be lower than the comfort temperature.
data_description.away_offset: When somebody is home but not in the room and the schedule asks for comfort, heat to comfort minus this value instead of the setback (not below eco). Leave empty to turn off.
data_description.away_schedule_mode: Use the reduced comfort also while nobody is home and the schedule asks for comfort. Otherwise the away temperature applies.
data_description.frost_after_absence: After nobody has been home this long, drop to frost protection (without one, to the thermostat minimum). 0 turns it off.
data_description.force_comfort_entities: Switches, sensors or timers, e.g. input_boolean.party. While one is on or active the room heats to comfort. A number at the end of the name ("Party 23") is used as the temperature. An open window wins.
data_description.force_eco_entities: While one of these is on the room stays at eco. Forced comfort wins.
data_description.follow_house_calendar: While a house calendar event runs, the room uses the schedule it names, or heats to comfort if the event asks for it.

geofencing.title: Geo-fencing and location quality
geofencing.description: Choose the distance and direction sensors from the same Proximity zone. Distance is normalized to meters. Old location updates are ignored after the maximum age.

data_description.proximity_zone: Pick the zone of the Proximity integration, for example Home. The distance and direction sensors of this room's people are found automatically. The zone only counts while none of these people is home; while at least one is home it sleeps.
data_description.proximity_distance: The upper distance for an approaching-to-home signal. Comparisons are normalized to meters.
data_description.proximity_duration: Direction must stay towards home and within range for this long. Changing distance readings do not restart the timer; direction/range changes and outages do.
data_description.proximity_max_age: If the distance sensor has not updated within this duration, the location is stale and cannot trigger a new heating decision.

environment.title: Window, outdoor temperature and weather
environment.description: Optional sensors refine safe setback and preheating. A configured window sensor must be available; otherwise no new thermostat target is written.

data.window_temperature: Temperature while window is open (°C, optional)
data.disable_trv_window_detection: Turn off the thermostats' window detection
data.window_change: Changes while a window is open
data.notify_away: Push when nobody is detected at home

data_description.window_entity: When ON, setback is enforced. If configured but unavailable, the controller avoids writing a new target.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Optional outdoor sensor used to refine the conservative preheat estimate.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional hourly weather forecast. Sunny daytime conditions can reduce the estimated preheat lead by at most 15 minutes.
data_description.heating_limit_temperature: At or above this outdoor temperature the room stays at the setback temperature, even during comfort periods, and preheating is skipped. Normal heating resumes once it is 1 °C cooler. Uses the outdoor sensor, otherwise the weather entity temperature. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.window_open_delay: Setback starts only after the window stayed open this long. Short airing or a draft does not change the setpoint. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_close_delay: After closing, the window setback is kept this long so the room air settles. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_temperature: Own setpoint while a window is open, e.g. 15 °C. Leave empty to use the eco or away temperature as before. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.heating_season_entity: Switch or sensor for the heating season, e.g. a winter mode. While it is OFF the room is not heated: the setpoint goes to the frost protection temperature or, without one, the thermostat minimum. If the entity is unavailable, heating continues normally. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.notify_service: Notify service for your phone, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. While control is on it reports thermostat problems or a failed room sensor after 30 minutes, blocked control after 30 minutes, heating problems, frost risk and a window open for over an hour in the heating season. Leave empty to turn off.
data_description.window_drop_detection: When the room cools by 1 °C within 10 minutes it is lowered for 15 minutes as with an open window. Works in addition to a window contact.
data_description.disable_trv_window_detection: While control is on and the room has a window contact, turn off the thermostats' own window detection (switch …_window_detection), so no valve closes on its own while the room should heat.
data_description.additional_window_entities: If any of them is open, the room counts as open, with the same delays. An extra contact that drops out counts as closed.
data_description.humidity_entity: The humidity is shown on the room thermostat.
data_description.door_entities: Room doors with their own, usually longer delay, so a door opened briefly does not lower the room.
data_description.door_open_delay: The room is lowered only once a door stayed open this long.
data_description.door_close_delay: After the door is closed the setback stays this long.
data_description.zone_window_entities: Contacts that affect several rooms, e.g. the patio door. Add them to every affected room.
data_description.zone_window_open_delay: The room is lowered only once one of these stayed open this long.
data_description.zone_window_close_delay: After closing the setback stays this long.
data_description.window_change: A setpoint changed at a valve or the room thermostat while a window is open never heats right away. It is kept and applied once the window is closed, or discarded.
data_description.heating_limit_average: Uses the mean weather forecast of the next two days, without a forecast the mean of the outdoor sensor over the last two days, so one warm afternoon does not stop heating. Off = current outdoor temperature.
data_description.heating_limit_fallback_off: Without any outdoor temperature the heating limit counts as reached. Off = keep heating as before.
data_description.notify_away: With a button "Not true, I'm here". One room sends it for the whole house.

data_description.notify_service: For the weekly report, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.house_calendar: Calendar or schedule for the whole house. A running event picks the schedule its title or "zeitplan: Ferien" names in every room. With "komfort: an" or "temperature: 21" in the description it is comfort time in every room.

copy_settings.title: Copy settings
copy_settings.description: Writes the chosen settings of one room to other rooms. Devices (thermostats, sensors, schedules, the room's window and door contacts) are never copied. The target rooms are reloaded afterwards.

intelligence.title: Smart control
intelligence.description: The room model learns from every hour how strongly the radiators heat, how fast the room cools and how much sun and wind matter. It times preheating, limits the setback so the room is warm again in time and stops heating early at the end of a comfort block. It only acts once it has enough data (sensor "Raummodell").

data.recovery_limit: Set back only as far as the room can recover
data.preheat_when_home: Preheat while somebody is home (even if the room is empty)
data.learn_usage: Learn when the room is used
data.room_empty_grace: Comfort start: wait this long for somebody in the room
data.early_stop: Stop heating before comfort ends (0 = off)
data.punctuality: Warm on time: learn preheating from late mornings
data.preheat_extension: Preheating may take this much longer (0 = never)

data_description.recovery_limit: Outside comfort time the room must get warm again within the maximum preheat time.
data_description.learn_usage: At times the room is usually used, comfort is kept even without motion.
data_description.early_stop: Only if the room loses at most 0.5 °C until the end.
data_description.punctuality: Every morning checks whether the room was warm when comfort began and learns how much earlier or later to preheat.
data_description.preheat_extension: On top of the maximum preheat time, only when the central heating is not usually off then.

implausible_room_temperature.title: Implausible room temperature in {room}
implausible_room_temperature.description: The room sensor {entity} reports {value} °C. The value is ignored and the room is controlled with the thermostats' readings. A flat battery is a common cause. This goes away once plausible values come in again.

selftest_failed.title: Self-test in {room} found problems
selftest_failed.description: The self-test after the start found: {problems}. It repeats hourly; this goes away once everything is fine. The "Selbsttest starten" button repeats it now.
